content_sections.heading: NEHU Guest Faculty Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: There is no written examination. Selection is made through an Interview conducted by the concerned department. The University reserves the right to shortlist candidates to be called for interview; meeting the essential qualifications alone does not guarantee an interview call. The date and time of the interview will be notified by the concerned department. For external candidates, the interview may be conducted online. No TA/DA will be paid to candidates for attending the interview.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NEHU Guest Faculty Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Important: No application will be entertained after the last date and time. Only online applications are accepted; there is no offline mode.

content_sections.heading: Important Conditions
content_sections.text: Selection for Guest Faculty is made by the University purely on a temporary basis. The term of appointment is for the current semester only, or till a regular faculty member joins the department, whichever is earlier. The posts are purely for a defined short duration and are of the nature of Guest Faculty – not regular or permanent positions. Eligibility criteria and other terms and conditions follow UGC Regulations, 2018/AICTE latest regulations, and their subsequent notifications/guidelines.

faq.question: Q1. How many Guest Faculty posts has NEHU notified in 2026?
faq.answer: NEHU has notified 107 Guest Faculty posts across 43 departments in 8 Schools, on both the Shillong and Tura campuses.

faq.question: Q2. Is NEHU Guest Faculty a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. Selection is purely temporary, for the current semester or until a regular faculty member joins, whichever is earlier.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for NEHU Guest Faculty Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: 31 August 2026, through the online portal only.

faq.question: Q4. What is the remuneration for NEHU Guest Faculty?
faq.answer: ₹1,500 per lecture, subject to a maximum of ₹50,000 per month, with no other allowances, medical reimbursement, or vacation salary.

faq.question: Q5. Is there a written exam for NEHU Guest Faculty positions?
faq.answer: No, selection is through an interview only, conducted by the concerned department.

faq.question: Q6. Can candidates outside Meghalaya apply for NEHU Guest Faculty?
faq.answer: The notification is open to Indian Nationals; for external candidates, the interview may be conducted online.

faq.question: Q7. What is the eligibility criteria for NEHU Guest Faculty posts?
faq.answer: As per UGC Regulations, 2018/AICTE latest regulations for the relevant subject/department, along with the specialization requirements listed against each department.
